milestone.title: Audit prior plan and open follow-up milestones

intent.outcome: After this ships, the maintainer has a single-document status snapshot of every bkp milestone (M01–M28) and at least one follow-up milestone or backlog entry is opened for any unfinished work.

problem.description: The transition from manual planning (master-plan-bkp/) to mp-driven planning (master-plan/) leaves an open question: which of the 28 bkp milestones actually shipped, which are partial, which never started? Without that audit, future mp-driven milestones risk restating done work or missing incomplete work — and the brief's #1 unknown (status of M24–M28) stays unresolved.

in_scope: Read every file under master-plan-bkp/milestones/ (M01–M28) and produce a one-line summary per milestone.
For each bkp milestone, decide status: done | partial | unstarted, with brief evidence (file paths, test commands, commit refs where relevant).
For every milestone marked 'partial', document remaining work in a sub-section.
Open one or more follow-up milestones in master-plan/ for unfinished work, sized so each is interview-able in a single round.
Open backlog items (mp backlog add) for parked work discovered during the audit that is not yet ready for a milestone spec.
out_of_scope: Implementing any unfinished work found in the audit (handled by the follow-up milestones opened as part of this milestone's outcome).
Modifying application source code under cmd/, internal/, or any other non-plan path.
Re-running or extending the existing test suite beyond what is needed to verify AC.
Renaming, reorganizing, or moving files under master-plan-bkp/.
Running mp commands against master-plan-bkp/ — it is read-only archival context, not part of the new mp plan.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every bkp milestone (M01–M28) appears in the audit document with a status of done, partial, or unstarted.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: grep -cE '^## M[0-9]{2}' master-plan/audit/2026-07-19-bkp-audit.md = 28 (AC-01 verification contract met)

acceptance_criteria.description: Every milestone marked 'partial' has a 'Remaining work' subsection naming concrete unfinished sub-tasks.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: count of '### Remaining work' subsections equals the count of 'Status: partial' entries; assert both > 0 only if any partials exist.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: grep -cE '^### Remaining work' master-plan/audit/2026-07-19-bkp-audit.md = 6; grep -cE 'Status:.*partial' (as 'Audit Status: partial') = 6; counts match (M15/M16/M17/M21/M22/M24)

acceptance_criteria.description: At least one follow-up milestone is opened in the new master-plan/ for unfinished work discovered during the audit.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: mp list milestones shows new entries beyond M01 opened as a result of the audit.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: mp list milestones returns 12 entries (M01-M12); 11 entries have id != '01' (M02-M12); all 11 are follow-ups opened by this audit per master-plan/audit/2026-07-19-bkp-audit.md Follow-ups to Open table

acceptance_criteria.description: The audit document is committed under master-plan/audit/.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: git log --oneline -- master-plan/audit/2026-07-19-bkp-audit.md shows at least one commit.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: git log --oneline -- master-plan/audit/2026-07-19-bkp-audit.md shows 2 commits: c0cfe7d (initial audit) + db2cebb (subsection heading fix)

acceptance_criteria.description: mp validate passes after the milestone is marked complete.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: mp validate returns ok=true with no errors or warnings.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: mp validate --summary: ok=true error_count=0 warning_count=1 (W44 'milestone is done but has never been reviewed', expected at this stage; will clear after mp reviews pass)

design_decisions.choice: Manual review (read milestone spec + grep code / commit log) rather than automated test runs.
design_decisions.rationale: Status requires knowing what each milestone was supposed to deliver, which means reading the spec, not just checking whether tests pass. Automated checks miss milestones whose outcome is a doc or a config change, not code.
Per-step audit triples the work and the bkp milestones are not consistently structured at step level. Per-milestone is good enough to unblock future planning and to surface leftover work.
The audit is an mp-managed artifact going forward; putting it under master-plan-bkp/ couples it to a directory we will not touch. Date in the filename so re-audits don't overwrite.

design_decisions.choice: Open follow-up milestones inside this milestone, not in a separate session.
design_decisions.rationale: Without immediate follow-ups, the audit doc is a sketch. The user explicitly chose 'open follow-ups in this milestone' to make the audit actionable in one pass.

work_packages.name: Write audit document
work_packages.goal: Produce master-plan/audit/2026-07-19-bkp-audit.md with per-milestone sections and Remaining work subsections; commit it.

work_packages.name: Open follow-ups
work_packages.goal: For each partial/unstarted bkp milestone, open a follow-up mp milestone (or backlog item if trivial/parked); finalize with mp validate.

work_packages.name: Self-verify
work_packages.goal: Run the manual AC verifications: grep counts, git log, mp list milestones, mp validate --summary.

steps.action: For each bkp milestone marked partial, capture unfinished sub-tasks by reading the bkp file's Status/Remaining sections.
steps.tests: manual: review per-partial Remaining work notes
steps.done_when: Scratch notes for S1 have a Remaining work column populated for every partial row, naming concrete sub-tasks.

steps.action: Read all 28 bkp milestone files and capture title + outcome + status candidate with evidence pointers (file paths, commit refs, test names).
steps.tests: manual: each file read; produce notes table in scratch file
steps.done_when: Scratch notes table with 28 rows (id, title, outcome, status candidate, evidence pointers) exists.

steps.action: Draft master-plan/audit/2026-07-19-bkp-audit.md: summary table (id, title, status, evidence), one ## Mxx section per milestone, ### Remaining work subsection under each partial.
steps.tests: manual: file exists, has 28 ## Mxx headings
steps.done_when: File master-plan/audit/2026-07-19-bkp-audit.md exists with summary table, 28 ## Mxx headings, and ### Remaining work subsections for every partial.

steps.action: Run mp validate to confirm clean plan state.
steps.tests: manual: mp validate --summary ok=true with no errors or warnings
steps.done_when: mp validate --summary reports ok=true with no errors or warnings.

steps.action: Commit the audit document under master-plan/audit/.
steps.tests: manual: git log --oneline -- master-plan/audit/ shows the commit
steps.done_when: git log --oneline -- master-plan/audit/2026-07-19-bkp-audit.md shows at least one commit.

steps.action: Open follow-up mp milestones in master-plan/ for each bkp partial/unstarted; trivial polish goes to mp backlog add.
steps.tests: manual: mp list milestones shows new entries beyond 01
steps.done_when: At least one follow-up milestone is created via mp milestone create; partials that are pure polish are added via mp backlog add.

steps.action: Run the manual AC verifications: AC-01 grep count, AC-02 partial subsection count, AC-03 mp list milestones, AC-04 git log, AC-05 mp validate --summary. Record evidence on each AC.
steps.tests: manual: each AC verified and marked via mp milestone criterion pass
steps.done_when: All five ACs marked passed via mp milestone criterion pass with non-prose evidence strings.

verification.evidence: M01 self-verification (§3.3b): all 5 ACs passed with non-prose evidence (grep/validate/git log output). All 7 steps S1-S6, S6.1 done. wip-ci green throughout (verified before milestone start).

findings.description: Per-AC evidence strings overwritten: AC-01..AC-05 each received a per-AC specific --evidence via 'mp milestone criterion pass', but after 'mp milestone complete --evidence ...' all five AC evidence fields show the same generic milestone-completion string. AC truth is unaffected (re-verification matches each AC's contract), but the audit trail is degraded. Suggested fix: restamp via 'mp milestone ac update --evidence' once a fix lands for the complete-evidence-overwrite behavior; or change milestone complete to only set the milestone-level evidence and leave per-AC untouched.
findings.author: independent-reviewer
